notes.title: Update - Multiplayer says goodbye!
notes.content:
Multiplayer has been removed from Fossilfuel with this update.

It seems that not many people are actively engaging in the multiplayer aspect of the game, almost all new players are playing the single-player. It doesn't make much sense to promote the game as a multiplayer experience at this point as the servers are empty. 

Additionally, I'd like to remind you that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2299660/Fossilfuel_2/]Fossilfuel 2 [/url]store page is now live. Be sure to follow updates for the exciting continuation of the epic Fossilfuel storyline!

Dangerous Bob

notes.title: Fossilefuel 2 Steam Game Store Up!
notes.content:
It is time. 
[h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2299660/Fossilfuel_2/?beta=0][i]Fossilfuel 2[/i] is officially in development! [/url][/h3]

[i]Fossilfuel 2[/i] will focus on building out the best aspects of the first game. Players revisit the [i]Sierra Research Facility[/i], which has been flooded with seawater, as the base sinks into the ocean. 

As such the game will focus more on aquatic dinosaurs, such as Dunkleosteus, which I feel don't get much attention in games. Old favorites will still return such as the Utahraptor. Water plays a much bigger part in the game, players must drain flooded hallways, dodge giant Angler fish, and more.  

[i]Fossilfuel 2[/i] is being built on Unreal Engine 5, and as such will be the best-looking [i]DangerousBob[/i] game to date! 

The game will be much larger than the original, with a target runtime of 12 hours, and be even more horror focused, with more exploration and replay value! 

Be sure to check it out!

notes.title: So what the heck just happen? Read on
notes.content: Ok so here it goes. I ran an update a few days ago and accidentally uploaded the demo overtop of the main game which messed up a lot of code, specifically level travel. I quickly fixed all this and it should be fine now. These small updates are me just fixing some stuff from that fallout. Unfortunately, there is a bit of a big update here in gig size because I had to reupload some old maps to fix this. Honestly if you want to keep your game file size down, re-install (your saves will be fine). Basically, how Steam works is you can add files and copy over files but you can't remove files. So it just kind of keeps stacking. If you do notice something odd please post and I'll fix it. Hopefully, we won't have to go back to 1.10. Sorry about that, I am sure a lot of you were confused. All this to fix some simple key mapping issues on the xbox controller - ugh.

notes.title: RAPTOR ISOLATION DLC - OUT NOW
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1752320/Fossilfuel_Raptor_Isolation/]Raptor Isolation is DLC[/url] for Fossilfuel that expands on the horror aspect of the game. 


A major response to the original Fossilfuel, was that the players wanted more horror and less shooter gameplay. This has answered that call.

The Sierra Silo, the north wing of the base, deep in Alaskan Ice, houses more secrets for the player to uncover. Unlike in the main Fossilfuel game, this part of Sierra has no weapons. A Utahraptor has gotten the scent of fresh meat and made its way into the base to hunt down survivors after the base loses power. You play as a lone employee trying to just find an exit, but lucky for you there is more than one as Raptor Isolation offers multiple endings.

Download the exciting DLC and get a taste of fear today!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1752320/Fossilfuel_Raptor_Isolation/]STEAM STORE[/url]

notes.title: V1.05 Tutorials, Fix Blud Keycard, and working on FPS
notes.content:
For this patch, the following was updated:

I've gotten a lot of negative reviews based on the game being too hard. So now there are green prompts that jump up to help the player in some of the harder parts of the game (mainly the first encounter and the trench battle on the tank level where you get the secret rocket launcher). 

The Blue Keycard is fixed. A user was able to figure out what was causing it. Basically, if you picked up the keycard, the blue one, with a full inventory, it wouldn't work. This was caused by a code bug- when you replaced an item in the inventory it was spawning a new keycard to put in the inventory and that one wasn't aligned properly with the door. Now it is fixed!

Trying to get the FPS up on the bigger maps. You should see some improvement. I tested the tank level at 30 fps on a 5700XT, but I would like to be at 60 on the big maps and 120 on the smaller ones (The smaller maps averaged 90 fps, which is ok).

That is all for now, 

Happy hunting!

DangerousBob
The Dev

notes.title: v1.03 Fix the FOV on the guns when they aim
notes.content: With the last patch I added the ability to adjust the FOV in the options and it was bugging out on the guns when you would aim, now that is fixed.

notes.title: v1.02 Your voices heard! More Music, FOV, Checkpoints and bunch of other tweaks.
notes.content:
Hello, Dino fans!

Thank you for all the activity in the forums! I have sent out a patch trying to address most of the notes I got. 

The following:

-There was a big request for more checkpoints in the game. I have gone through and sprinkled more checkpoints throughout the game to hopefully help some of those struggling with the difficulty. 

-I have also added some more music. I originally wanted to keep the music limited, to increase the horror tension, but I agree in the end, some more ambient music is a good choice. 

-Added the option for FOV (Field of View) in the menu. I only got one request for this, but it was an easy one to add in.

A few other small gameplay tweaks were made. The black hole gun doesn't dish out so much damage vs bosses. Added some electrical traps you can use to fry the dino spider with. The Snipers make a clear sound when they fire at you.

Fixed a very strange bug that only happens on hard mode. The Lizard Mutant boss health bar wasn't working right, so now it works correctly. 

That is all for now! 

Happy hunting,

DangerousBob,
The Dev.

notes.title: V1.01 Fixed the dang Crosshair after loading screens.
notes.content:
Just a small little patch on a bug that I have been meaning to get out for awhile. When changing levels, you'll notice the crosshairs on the gun can get "stuck" on the dot. 

I ran some code now that checks for that at the start of each load screen. 

Also, the Achievement for the Queen Spider / Meganeuropsis Hybrid is now working correctly (You get it when you defeat the Queen the second time). 

Some spawns have been slightly adjusted to raise enemy number count as well.

All and all, the launch day went very well!
Please keep posting to the community and leave a review if you like the game. 

That is all for now!

DangerousBob

notes.title: V0.53 Added Game Pause to Menu / Inventory, & quick equip items
notes.content:
Small patch this week. 

The ability to pause the game was a frequent request in the forum.

Now when using the menu (Default Esc) the game will pause, as well as when using the inventory (Default Tab). 

Players can bind items to the 1,2,3 and 4 keys on their keyboard. 
Any item in the first 4 inventory slots will be bound to these keys.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2baa8TG.png[/img]

notes.title: V0.52 NEW Dinos, Cheat Codes, and Working Keyboard Bindings, Oh My!
notes.content:
This update focused on getting a lot of the community-reported bugs and adding some community ideas.

[b]New Dinos:[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AEqnh4N.png[/img]
[b]Stegosaurus[/b]
This big friendly giant gets its own paddock in the subterranean biodome. Friendly, they will only attack if provoked. But once they come after you, you better watch out for their spiked tail!

[b]Beelzebufo [/b]
A giant killer frog! Why don't more games have monster frogs? A frog that could suck up your children like flies, these big bad boys will now be roaming the halls of Sierra. They like it wet, and they are not too smart. Quickly evading them, they will give up the chase. 

[b]Bugs and Changes:[/b]
-The Menu and settings should be in good shape now
-Buff the flame thrower, doubled the damage
-Snake boss battle has been heavily tweaked
-Added a recurring trap, an electrical box that you can shoot to zap enemies
-Tweaked the Trex pathing so it shouldn't get stuck so easy
-Hurt Screen is a lot faster now when you get shot
-Fixed the Shield texture on the Shield Soldier 
-Lowered the intro volume
-Blue Card inventory bug is now fixed
-You can discard the ABC note
-Crouching more quickly charges stamina 
-The AK weapon, you get earlier in the game now
-The booster shot also reduces the damage you take now
-Fixed turret bug where it would respawn the head after destroyed
-Fixed a bug where you could shoot during cutscenes
-Some minor tweaks to the story levels, moved some cover and a few enemies spawns around
-You can not carry over your guns to a new game now, you have to start fresh on a new game. This was done so speedrunners have an equal starting point

[b]CHEATS![/b]

When you complete the game you can play around with some fun cheat codes in the settings menu.
You will have to play to find out what they are! Note if you have already completed the game you will need to load up your save and fight one of the last bosses again to unlock the cheat menu.

That is all for now. Keep up the good work in the forums, I check them regularly and they were key to getting a lot of these bugs fixed!!

(Note this update is for the full game. These updates will eventually be brought over to the demo).

Best, 
DangerousBob

notes.title: Fix the C4 Wall bug.
notes.content: There was a slight error in the last patch where the C4 wall in the Raptor ambush was not working via a broken bit of code in the last patch. This has been corrected.

notes.title: Free Roam should now be working
notes.content:
Large maps are hard to do. The Free Roam map (currently just called Mountain Top) was eating up all the VRam of the user and giving a Fatal Error. By working my coder magic on the map, this should no longer be the case. 

Right now my focus is getting the game size down, reducing errors, and increasing the overall smoothness of gameplay. 

A reminder that all multiplayer maps can be played with friends or just one person.

Happy Hunting!

notes.title: Reduced Game Size!
notes.content:
Hello, 

This update reduces the game size to about 12 gigs. This was done by reducing many of the 4k textures on small in-game models that really have no impact on gameplay, by compressing them, the game files have greatly been reduced. This will help with frame rate and load times as well.

A re-install on steam is recommended to get the benefits of this reduction in-game size. 

You will [u]not [/u]lose your save games if you do a fresh re-install.

notes.title: V0.51
notes.content:
A small patch that tweaks the following:

-Added "money crates" to the main story game. These crates have 500 credits in them. Watching Lets Play videos, players didn't seem to be using the in-game shops because of the scarcity of currency in-game. This should help that. 

-Controler can be used in the shop menu

-Volume in the menu saves when you exit

-Fixed a bug with enemies getting stuck on some doors

-Loaded variables after session created on free roam should help with fatal errors

notes.title: UPDATE v0.5 COOP MISSION FREE ROAM and more!
notes.content:
Hello!

In the Multiplayer you can now toggle what is called "COOP MISSIONS". This will be an area where new COOP maps can be added that have objectives vs the standard Horde mode. 

A new map has been added for this mode. FREE ROAM! You are on the surface of Sierra, you and your buddies can hunt down the enemy, make your own adventure and achievement hunt!

Tweaks: 

-Increase Shotgun fire rate 20%
-V-Sync works now
-Invert Pitch option added
-You can jump in mp with space bar now (Mp grenade throw key has been moved to [ALT])
-Fix the drone enemy
-Added Mouse sensitivity slider
-Key bindings have been cleaned up
-You can't just run past the Snake Boss now, you have to fight
-A Death Screen when you die
-Gamma brightness options

Please continue to post bugs as you find them! That is a big help.

Happy hunting, 

DangerousBob
